records.Name: Határ út, behind Ibis Hotel
records.geography_status: hotel_park_rear_landmark_verified; exact cruising section and access still unknown

reviewed_sources.evidence: Cruising city index includes Határ út behind Ibis under park/green area rather than licensed venue.
Original source detail still unreadable, no original GPS/directions.
Ibis Budapest Citysouth hotel located at Ferde utca 1, Budapest 1091, near Határ út M3 station (~170 metres north). Prior hotel landmark GPS 47.46437,19.12596.

KEY FIND: operator/community garden account identifies an 800m² community garden established 2016 in the hotel's REAR PARK, at Ferde utca 1, with visitor hours displayed as 08:00–20:00. This is an exact physical green space behind Ibis; not evidence that cruising took place there, and it is hotel-managed land.
2016 local notice corroborates the hotel community garden at Ferde Street, not the gay cruising claim.

records.cross_source_note: The back park is real and precisely associated with hotel. Not enough evidence to equate the claimed cruising zone to garden parcels or to infer permission for access after hours.
records.rewritten_description: The old cruising directory places this outdoor location behind the Ibis at Határ út. The hotel is Ibis Budapest Citysouth, Ferde utca 1; independent community-garden records identify a specific landscaped rear park on its grounds, developed into an 800 m² garden. This confirms the rear green-space landmark the original claim may describe, but no original map pin or recent firsthand activity establishes which section was used. Managed land and garden hours should not be treated as cruising access.
remaining: Obtain original 64788 map/directions and determine if entry refers to hotel rear park or a separate nearby strip
Check whether landscaped garden/open grounds have changed after 2016; no cruising claims based on garden website

records.Name: Rózsa utcai Duna-part
records.geography_status: named riverside place independently verified; original claimed specific area and GPS still not recovered

reviewed_sources.evidence: PRIMARY COMMENT READ: 2026-07-06 06:34:02 user says in Hungarian 'Szoktam erre kajakozni, mindig nezem is, de sose latok itt senkit' = regularly kayaks past this place and looks but never sees anyone. This is a first-person NEGATIVE observation, not evidence no activity ever.
KEY: Exact original detail URL was recovered from the city-index listing link; currently inaccessible. Prior archive erroneously said no unique original detail URL.

Independent Hungarian visitor-place index lists a distinct named Rózsa utcai Duna-part at Budapest, Rózsa u. 19, postal code 1214. Also carries warning about glass and shells in water; this is not cruising proof.
Budapest boundary regulation names Danube riverbank and Rózsa utca as boundary of Csepel-Rózsadomb, confirming the geographical shoreline reference; not a cruising report.

dated_reports.finding: Kayaker reports repeatedly looking and not seeing anyone; negative observation only.

source_landmark.scope: Named riverside attraction, not source-specific cruising pin

records.activity_confirmation: No dated positive meeting verified; one dated negative firsthand observation
records.rewritten_description: The named Rózsa Street waterfront on Csepel Island is independently listed as a Danube-side local attraction near Rózsa u. 19. A comment on the original cruising website dated 6 July 2026 describes a kayaker repeatedly passing and seeing nobody there. This is useful negative visitor context but not proof the place is never used. The original listing's individual link was recovered, though its own map remains inaccessible.
